intro.text: This is the specboard board screen, proving its own requirements.

cues.text: First, open the board detail — the two columns appear.
Then announce a golden value on the narration bar.
Finally, confirm the tests column is present.
R1 holds: every screen is one card, not a row of cells.
R1 broke: a screen is no longer a single card.
R4 holds: every requirement's state is computed and assertion-backed.
R4 broke: a requirement's state was not derived from its proof.
R8 holds: there is no acceptance gate — a requirement is canon the moment it is written.
R8 broke: an acceptance gate has come back.
R10 holds: a test opens to its full evidence, and the recording narrates itself.
R10 broke: the evidence or the self-narration is missing.
R13 holds: three views of a screen — focus, list, and columns.
R13 broke: one of the three views is gone.
R14 holds: the proof is scannable as frames, not only as video.
R14 broke: the proof frames are missing.

outro.text: That is the board, proving itself.
